# Tool selection: image credits

The files `anna-tei.webp` and `anna-markdown.webp` were created on October 20, 2026 with the integrated image generator for this prototype. Both show fictitious working situations and abstract work views, no real screenshots of oXygen or other products. The images are marked as AI illustration.

## TEI/oXygen – actually used prompt

Use case: illustration-story. Editorial gouache and pencil illustration for scholarly edition website, landscape 3:2. Warm irry, midnight teal, sage, terracotta palette with paper textures. Close view of a woman editor's hand using a laptop next to an open historical book and annotations. Screen shows a call structured editing workspace as abstract shapes and highlighted passage, no legible text, no logos, no actual product screenshot. Convey a prepared friendly digital working environment for careful text editing, TEI and XML tools. Elegant literary magazine illustration, matching a warm painted researcher desk scene. No photorealism, no faceting in image.
